The kernel compiles, passes correctness (5/5 trials), and shows a small but real speedup over the PyTorch reference.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Compiled | true |
| Correctness | 5/5 |
| Runtime (mean) | 1.98 ms |
| Ref runtime (mean) | 2.08 ms |

The kernel follows the same one-thread-per-output-element pattern as the verified max reduction example, adapted for argmin by tracking both a bf16 minimum value and an i64 index through the serial scan over the reduction axis. The wrapper handles all three dim values (0, 1, 2) by permuting the input so the reduction axis always lands at dim=1 before launching the kernel.
